The book in the middle

Cella slid the book to the middle so they could both read it.

Reading side by side is one of the oldest ways to keep someone company.

For the friend who reads you the good parts.

alt: A short film with no voice and no text, with music. A room with a window. A small amber block figure with white eyes on the left stands beside a closed book, while a royal blue figure on the right looks over with narrowed eyes. The black one leans and the book slides to the middle of the floor and opens. The blue one's eyes go wide and then happy with a pulse, a page turns, and the black one smiles.
